panels.description: Schema coverage is the share of reachable packages carrying a packageType, i.e. re-fetched since the field was introduced. Resync progress is how far the current reindex queue has drained. Denominator is up-to-date + out-of-date, i.e. documents the metadata updater can actually reach. Deleted, faulty and JSON-parse-error documents are excluded: the status view files them under keys the updater never drains, so including them would cap this below 100% forever.
panels.title: Metadata completeness

panels.description: Backlog falls as the updater re-fetches; classified rises as those fetches land. They should converge.
